issues: 34.2 - minor source-precision nit (not a fidelity error): Source lists 'Message Translator' as a Ch. 8 item; the pattern itself is defined in Ch. 3 (p. 85). Ch. 8 is titled Message Transformation, its introduction frames the chapter as 'specific variants of the Message Translator (85)', and the claim the principle actually rests on ('messages between an application and its own translator are private') is in Ch. 8's Canonical Data Model section, p. 358 - so the cited chapter does carry the supporting text and the pointer is findable.
